title: Energetic Forum
content_preview:
Hello from Freefuel in Ottawa, Canada
I worked in the manufacturing engineering group in electronics manufacturing for a number of years. I am not an engineer but who likes to work on various electro-mechanical projects. I am now retired. Recently I have been concerned about the price of gas and what can be done about it.
As I was surfing the internet I became aware of people using HHO to help improve their gas milage. What a good idea! I haven't built anything yet but I'm getting ready to start.
Your forum came up as I was browsing and I decided that this is the place I want to be.
I was wondering if anyone is using an EFIE using the LM3914 led bar driver. I seem to like the idea of having a rotary switch to control the output to the CPU.
I'm waiting for my parts to arrive for the PWM and I'll put it together. As far as the electrolyzer is concerned I'm still not sure what would be best for my needs. I have a 95 Neon. I'm waiting for a ScanGuage I ordered to come in.
Thanks for having me folks and looking forward to getting some replies.
Freefuel

title: New business member
content_preview:
Hello to all;
I am an executive in a family run transportation company. I have been tinkering with high voltage and tesla coils since high school, but am self taught and not really a scientist. I would however like to issue a challenge. The industrial revolution was a success because real work was being performed more cheaply, more efficiently, and with less manpower. This economy of the steam engine and other inventions relieved man of burdensome and repetitive tasks and made all men richer. Until real working devices are available to people like me to replace my diesel engines that can work as well or better, be cheaper to operate and be more reliable WITHOUT GOVERNMENT INTERFERENCE i.e. no manhattan project for alternate energy, these interesting devices will remain just that and no more.
If anyone can build something which will reliably run a school bus (which I have and can make available) we are accomplishing little. I would be willing to work with interested parties who are capable to make such a thing a reality. It is time we go beyond shaky, blurred Youtube videos of crudely made benchtop devices.
Should we be successful, I do not want any royalties or ownership or any money. I want to run my buses with free environmental energy of some type and reap the cost savings of not having to buy diesel (I spend $45,000 to $50,000 per month in diesel) I would also like any such breakthroughs to be made freely available to all world wide. Until this is done it will be difficult to break the control our government has over us primarily due to our energy policies and our fiat currency. To anyone who is capable of building a free energy powerplant to replace a diesel engine there would be plenty of money to be made retrofitting trucks and buses without resorting to patents. I believe it is this secrecy on the parts of inventors like T Henry Moray and E V Gray which has prevented this from becoming a reality. Should some successful invention be made a part of the public

title: Looking for Renewable Energy and found PATHS
content_preview:
Hi All,
I found this forum whilst researching renewable energy. Specifically the Bedini motor, Tesla and EV Gray. I watched a Dr. Peter Lindemann vid and then ended up here.
As I have been also changing my life over the last 4 years by going down the path of LOA, movies like The Secret, What the Bleep (All 10 hours or so), Abraham Hicks etc, PATHS immediately struck a chord with me and the Synchronistic nature of my discovery was not lost on me :-)
However I also have my online marketing business and have 16 years of professional Internet experience, so I had my skeptics hat on even when I was purchasing. What got me over the line was finding a local aff. (Sharyn Hayes) and I contacted her directly and spoke with her. As it turned out her husband had been subscribing to my online marketing newsletter for ages. Wow eh?
That, combined with the info Sharyn provided was enough for me to take the plunge. I started on the 7th of Aug....., 3 weeks ago.
I had set my wake up time to 6AM. SInce I tend to work late, getting up at this time AND being productive has been a bit of a struggle.
To cut a long story short I no longer have an alarm clock in my bedroom and I awake at 6AM every morning in a very productive state of mind. In fact I was in Vietnam from the 8th to the 15th where there is a 3 hour time difference and I woke up like clockwork at 3AM. DOH!
Anyway one of the mods I chose was BIz Productivity. Business has gone through the roof in the last 3 weeks. SO much so that I feel I need an organisation module and put on new staff.
So that is a bit good... and certainly worthy of at least 2 happy dances .
I still haven't visited the renewable energy forum yet as I've been so busy!
more to come.... :-)
Thanks

title: Honored to be here
content_preview:
I put this on my profile and realized it should be here.
I just wanted to say to anyone who might wander into my profile that I feel excited and honored to be among the posters of EnergeticForum. I tend to attract (or possibly seek out) the unusual and not-quite-mainstream. During my ramblings around the vast reaches of the net I have found that the things I encounter that interest me most and "sing in my heart" are the very things that Society views as unworthy of notice and deems fringe psudoscience. I think that the underlying viewpoint of helping humanity for the sake of humanity is what Mainstream Society doesn't promote or understand. I am often shocked by how many people teach and are taught to "look out for number one" because the others won't, can't and shouldn't care for anyone but themselves. I am asamed that my fellow humans have not grasped the fact that we are all interconnected with and through the world and,what is done to the least of us, impacts every other person and thing in the universe.
I cannot express how very happy it made me to find this bastion of light, where those few who understand the simple secret, that good done for the sake of good rewards the spirit and balms the soul, gather.
I can't be on this forum often due to time constraints but find it soothing to have it in my life now. Thank you all for your work, words and wisdom. I hope to be able to contribute something of worth to this righteous endeavor and will strive to do so.
Humbly,
Bast333

title: Hello from Johannesburg, South Africa
content_preview:
I have joined this forum mostly because of the information on renewable energy. I am optimistic that this millenimium will be the one that humanity will become truly free. Free in what we say, free exchange of ideas, free energy and free to use technology like we want to.
Today we have many more ways people can communicate with each other. So much so that the world have been called a "global village" and fast, free electronic communication the "information super-highway". I wonder, indeed, what our limitations are with all these advancements? Somewhere in the movie "Contact" the priest (Palmer Joss/Mathew McConaughy) in the story says "Is the world fundamentally a better place because of science and technology? We shop at home, we surf the Web... at the same time, we feel emptier, lonelier and more cut off from each other than at any other time in human history..." <looked up the exact quote>
I want to ask the question why should this be, that we become more distant from one another? We should remain the masters of technology and should not let technology rule us and take over our lives. We do need to carefully plan the ways we utilise technology; it is clear the old labour driven economies of yesteryear is behind us although countries like China still employs many industry workers. But once technology becomes more economically feasible many industries close down; this should be foreseeable.
Where are all our great visionaries and leaders that they never seem to adequately address the repercussions of such paramount changes. Work should be exciting and one should have a sense of accomplishment doing ones job well, but if most jobs are reduced to assembly line of work where some higher power decide the output and constraint of our working environment then I can scarcely see the point of human history. To me that is that progress is good and that change is inevitable; but due to various reasons of human psychology our so-called leaders have ongoing popularity contests

I have been experimenting with alum battery conversions and have some

alum. Mainly how do I guarantee they won't freeze I am also curious about some of their behaviors and capacity.
I was also curious what would happen if my electric car were setup with
a tesla switch concept placing a charging battery between the motor and
motive pack. I will put fairly specific information about it later but I am curious how fast it would go in a recovery mode, I assume only a few MPH.
To this end, I would like to build a solid state controller that allows independant access to each battery so it could "wire" the batteries in any order or configuration around the series wound motor, but the control aspect is what baffles me. AKA how do I setup a device to control the "mosfets firing order" My motive pack contains 9 8v trojan T875 190ahr batteries so most devices on this site would not handle it well. title: Hello, From Vancouver B.C. Canada
content_preview:
Hello Everyone,
My real name is Jon. I found this wonderful forum while browsing the internet at my parents house. My father and I were viewing 4X4 vids on youtube when my father asked me to google "run your car on water". We were tired of shelling out $80+ a week on gas so we did. And it led me to "Water fuel cell" -> Stan Myer -> Dave Lawton -> Panacea University -> Ravi's D14.pdf -> Aaron Murakami -> Energetic Forum. Maybe not all in that order but none the less, quite the journey!
My knowlege of electricity I would say is a "3.5 out of 10". I know most of the terms but little therory. While in High School I started making a 100 x 2 watt RMS Class AB audio amplifier with a friend at work. Unfortunitaly, he quit, and I never finished it.
Anyway, back to the water fuel cell. I plan on building one with my father. He has a shop with everything from an Oxygen / acetyline torch, 120 Tonne power press - to - soldering equipment, and electrical oscyliscope. (Mechanical to electrical) Pretty much all the equipment I need make a WFC (Water Fuel Cell).
Except the knowledge / theory behind it.
And that is why I am here. You won't find me posting many messages and jabbering because 95% of my time spent on this forum shall be reading (I have lots of catchup to do). I owe a lot to all of the knowledgable posters on this forum as well as other forums I have come across. The people who devote their time to developing free energy, or at least more efficient ways of producing energy. In my case, HHO (Hydroxy) I thank you! Together we (if my WFC works) will make the world a cleaner and more efficient place to live!
Anyway, that's enough from me.
Thanks for reading if you did.
-Lobo-

title: Greetings from Rotterdam
content_preview:
Hello to all of you,
I've recently joined this forum because of my great interest in alternative energy, and with that I'm not talking solar or hydro or whatever 'conventional' sources we already have but are not using. This universe still has lots of secrets to humanity, and yet we all seem to think that we've got it all figured out, well the most of it anyway. This is not what I believe. The things we know, and the scientific knowledge humanity has gathered till now are just the tip of the iceberg. How do I know? I don't, I just feel it.
Still at the relatively young age of 19, I hope I can contribute something to humanity, make a difference, not lust live a 'normal' life like the rest of the cattle. Things got to change, and have to do so quickly, or humanity is not going to remain existent.
By researching alternative, "outside the box" projects, like Bedini's work, Bearden's work, Tesla's work, and all the other great names which have been mostly ignored by the large scientific community, just because what they are/were researching "should not be able to hapen", I hope we will find a new truth, and with that combined with all the things we do know must be 100% true, we might be able to make this world a lot better. Even utopia maybe.
There's lots of work to do, so let's work together to get it done, in stead of working against each other to try and disprove things, lets try to PROVE things, especially the things that are so worth proving.
Well, thats my picture, hope someone agrees. Again, hello to all of the people here.

title: Don't make me laugh.........yet!
content_preview:
Well, good morning to all you rays of light across the world It is truly wonderful to be here typing my usual gibberish wondering where this note will be read. It is particularly wonderful as my actually went awfully quiet at the end of August. Silent in fact. It was very nearly and meet my face to face, a bit prematurely in my humble opinion!!
Anyway thanks to the wonders of modern drugs , surgery and who/whatever is out there looking after me is back thumping merrily
Enough of the emoticons! 48 year old conveyancing lawyer in Paignton (Devon, England) was chewing a toffee on Sunday 30 August 9pm and to cut a long story short I felt suddenly unwell and ended up in Hospital a few minutes later. I was rushed to Accident & Emergency and was laying on an assessment bed, with my son watching as they tried to resuscitate after a rather nasty heart attack (is there another kind?) Suffice to say if you are going to have one then in hospital next to a set of jump leads is a realllly good place to be.
Dicky ticker was successfully re-plumbed at end of September by a lovely axe wielder at Derriford Hospital and I am back at home sporting what is affectionately know in this neck of the woods a "Derriford Zip"
Recovery going ok and I hope to be fit for work in a month or so. In the meantime I have the unaccustomed luxury of a bit of time to think.
My thoughts have lead me by a slightly convoluted route to here, contemplating matters spiritual. Having visited the other side personally please accept my apologies but my visit was too short to gain any lasting impression further than flailing arms and legs as my nursey friends put he national grid through my nipples, so this particular journey is still based on faith rather than knowledge.
My faith? Hmmm well lets say I had a number of "experiences" whilst undergoing some healing training a couple of years back sufficient to convince me there is rather more to this life than meets the eye. (Straight to the naughty corner for anyone

content_preview:
Hi to all
As you can see my name is Jan-Willem and i live in Newcastle KZN South-Africa. I am actualy Afrikaans speaking so forgive me if you stumble upon some spelling errors
I have a particular interrest in the solid state bedini charger, and Steven Mark's TPU. I would like to learn more about these energy divices.
I am new to the electronics world (Total Rookie) but are facinated by all that electronics has to offer. I am very happy to know that there are some fellow South-Africans on the site, since I have had some trouble finding some parts that local shops can not supply so maybe we can share info on where to find some parts or replacment parts for that particular circuit.
I have reasently builded a SSG and upgraded it to a solid state.
I am keen to learn more and will take advice from all
Happy to have found this site
JW

Which brings me to what I'm doing here. I have a sneaky little feeling that sound is going to be key in unlocking the more than 4/5ths of the old grey matter we have and aren't using.

title: Hello from Florida
content_preview:
Hey guys,
I, like many others, have come here in search of a place to discuss the creation and construction of some free energy devices. I have been a big fan of Tesla's work for years now, and have also been following the work of others like Bearden, Lindemann, Bedini, Schauberger, Meyl, Johnson as well as many others.
After watching Energy from the Vacuum vol 10, I must have been distracted as I watched it with friends, when they printed the name of John Cejka on the screen. As I tried to find any information on a myriad of misspelled attempts at his last name, I came across an indexed thread on this site. As I began to look around and read multiple threads, I found myself wanting to become a member of this community.
So earlier today after waiting patiently for for a few days on my activation, I had sent an email off through the contact us link at the bottom of the page. This evening I received a very nice reply informing me my privileges had been increased and I could now post to the forums. So just wanted to say he, and I hope to talk to many of you in the future regarding some very interesting subjects!
Info-Seeker

title: Looking for SF Bay Area collaborator / helper
content_preview:
We are looking for a flexible/part time SF Bay Area fabricator and collaborator. Are you interested in Tesla/ Schauberger-inspired exotic technologies? Does improving human life motivate you?
We are Vadiance Science, a small company working dedicated to raising human consciousness and condition via
1. Free energy
2. Structured water-based tech
We are looking for a practical-minded technician or junior engineer experienced in FDM 3D Printing and CNC Machining. This is a good opportunity for a student or recent grad.
It is also a plus if you have any skills in: mechanical or electrical design, prototyping, metal casting, exotic technologies including resonant systems, etheric engineering, shape power.
Equally important is that you believe in and are passionate about helping humanity reach a new level via breakthrough exotic technologies.
Your Qualities:
1. Completely trustworthy
2. Expansive thinking not limited by mainstream beliefs
3. Resourceful and quick learner
4. Refined craftsmanship
5. Fluid brainstorming and collaboration
We have facilities in both Southern SF and Marin. You will work directly with an accomplished Stanford PhD in Electrical Engineering with a deep background in exotic technologies.

title: Hi, I'm new here...
content_preview:
Hello everyone and well done for engendering discussion on non mainstream-adulterated science!
I'm a multi-disciplinary independent researcher and I joined the forum for a few reasons. For one I am trying to get a comprehensible, accurate model of how electricity works. Dollard's Lone Pine Writings is an interesting start but still raises more questions than it answers. The plan for this is to understand electricity from a (decent) electrical engineer's point of view, and merge that with an understanding from, let's say, a cosmologers point of view (thunderbolts project comes fully recommended) and a decent doctor/healer point of view (would recommend Daniel Keown who merges western and eastern medicine via an electrical model of the body).
The pursuit of real science is of course a worthwhile endevour itself and needs no justification. However, one of the reasons I am focusing on this area of research is because a proper scientific foundation would be useful for a sizable off-grid movement; a mass of people going off-grid not only for its own sake but as a sensible response to the totalitarian state that appears to be slowly creeping up on us.
I work on the principle that when different strands of information start coming together in a comprehendable way, a bigger picture if you will, then one is generally on the path to truly understanding.
Anybody who can point me in the direction feel free to respond

title: graphene based harvester defies old paradigm, performs work with Brownian motion
content_preview:
Paradigms are changing folks!
Physicists build “energy harvesting” circuit from graphene – NaturalNews.com
https://www.naturalnews.com/2020-10-12-physicists-build-energy-harvesting-circuit-from-graphene.html
A team of physicists from the University of Arkansas (U of A) has successfully developed graphene-based circuits capable of providing nearly limitless power for small devices. Described in a paper published in the journal Physical Review E, the findings prove a theory the physicists developed at the U of A three yeas ago. This theory stated that freestanding graphene […]
The research conducted by the U of A scientists has been rather controversial. The idea that freestanding graphene has potential energy-harvesting capabilities refutes a well-known assertation by physicist Richard Feynman that the thermal motion of atoms, known as Brownian motion, cannot do work.
However, the U of A researchers found that at room temperature, the thermal motion of graphene does induce an alternating current in a circuit – something previously thought impossible. In addition, the researchers found that their design increased the amount of power delivered. They stated that they found that the diodes’ switch-like behavior actually amplified the power being delivered instead of reducing it. (Related: Energy from an unlikely source: A combination of microbes and graphene could make inexpensive and eco-friendly energy .)
“We also found that the on-off, switch-like behavior of the diodes actually amplifies the power delivered, rather than reducing it, as previously thought,” said Thibado. “The rate of change in resistance provided by the diodes adds an extra factor to the power.”
To prove that the diodes increased the circuit’s power, the scientists on the project used a relatively new field of physics called stochastic thermodynamics. This field uses a family of stochastic or random variables to better understand the non-equilibrium dynamics present in many microscopic systems.

I also have a experiment where I can make a fish aquarium of sea water, apply my technique to the water, then observe the salt settle to the bottom of the aquarium and be a very high salinity, with a cloudy band of 'brackish' water separating pure water above. I can measure the salinity above & below the cloudy band. Once this process is done, it lasts in the water for about 36 hours, and as time passes, the cloudy band of brackish water moves upward toward the top of the aquarium, until it eventually disappears. Once this happens, the salinity winds up back to my original mixture. I make the sea water at 1.026, just like the majority of the oceans in the world.
Once I've accomplished the first 2 experiments, I'm going to demonstrate how spraying a mist of the H3O2 at the top of the aquarium, directly on the spark plug & show how it can be used as a viable combustion fuel.
Hopefully this will lead to the financing necessary to put a fuel injected engine (GM 3100 or 3800) on a engine run stand, with a International dyno marine type on the run stand, in the back of my pickup. I need to use a Holley Terminator X ECU to optimize the tune, so electrical noise disrupting the computer is going to be an issue.
I am looking forward to as much guidance as possible, as I'm not real familiar with electric circuits, I'm a plumber by trade.

title: Three-Phased nature of reality!
content_preview:
​ Ever since I was a teenager, I was baffled by the idea that reality relied on unexplained “quantum magic.”
The first clue that something deeper was going on came from E = h f . Why should energy come in discrete packets tied directly to frequency? QM never gave a causal explanation—photons were simply declared to be point particles that somehow spin, radiate no energy, and travel forever as both a particle and a wave.
For years, that never sat well with me.
While studying Tesla’s ideas and the significance of 3‑6‑9, something clicked.
Nature gives us three spatial dimensions , and three is also the minimum number of axes required to define a stable, rotating, resonant structure. What if every fundamental process in nature—including free electromagnetic vibration—was inherently three‑phased ?
Not metaphorically, but literally: three orthogonal induction phases separated by 120?, forming a complete cycle.
This led me to formulate my theory: Discrete Continuity — A Theory of Super‑Asymmetry
The basic postulate is simple:
Space is made of discrete points, and particles arise as distortions, twists, and curls of this discrete fabric.
These distortions must interact with the spatial lattice in three phases—because that is the only configuration that maintains resonance and stability. And what happens inside the distortions is what generates the quantum effects, spin, charge, mass, inertia that we experience in undistorted space. So according to discrete continuity, particles actually interact with real 3D space, not fields existing in hyperspace like in QFT.
Following this idea forward led me to a natural explanation for why particles have spin, charge, quantized energy , and why photons appear as discrete packets:
quantization is simply the allowed resonant modes of a three‑phase spatial medium.

content_preview:

My name is Andy, I’ve been exploring how geometry, mass, and gravity can be applied in ways that go beyond conventional explanations. The Mass Torque System is my attempt to demonstrate how small inputs can leverage large outputs through controlled torque and balance. In one demo, .23 oz of input force moves a 10.50 oz sled — a 4565% increase.
I’m not suggesting new energy is created, only that mechanical advantage can be harnessed in a novel way. content_preview:
Hi folks.

title: Career Advice Renewable Energy
content_preview:
Hi to all,
I am currently working in UK as a Building Services/ Energy/ Carbon consultant. I have been working from last 3 years and have done qualifications like EcoHomes, Code for Sustainable Homes and worked as a BREEAM assessor in commercial sector. However my highest qualification is MSc Energy, Environmental Technology & Economics and my first degree was Electronics Engineering. I have recently been involved in various Wind Turbine, PV and Heat Pumps technical feasibility studies and financial appraisals and carbon calculations.
I need an advice to enhance my career within Renewable Energy and Carbon Trading market by virtue of what kind of professional qualifications available within these fields which help me enhance my career. I am very keen to acquire any qualifications which will boost my future as currently I am stuck within building services only and trying to move on but due to recession etc I am unable to grow at all. Therefore I shall be grateful if any one please advise me what I should do to move on.
Thanks alot for your sincere advice.

title: Energetic Forum
content_preview: Hello all, I am a newbee to this forum and don't know if there is any topic protocol, but I think the best way in is to just jump, so here goes. Has anyone out there built or is in the process of building a MEG generator. This design perfected by Bearden and verified by J. L. Naudin. I am currently in the process of using toroids as transformers and possibly energy extractors. Not yet achieved overunity and have not proved out aelf running capability which indeed would prove out I would think, overunity energy output. My design has two paths, one using a large 3 inch dia. toroid in a MEG configuration. The other is the conventional dual 'C' cores but instead of steel or iron I have a ferrite device. Any information would be helpful as this is a long process and many dead ends have been encountered. I've seen quite a bit of desgns but they all seem to fall short of that crutial question, Does the magnet really add any signifigant energy to the output or just provide a better coupling mechanism . Any ideas out there, feel free to comment. Thanks, Elektricman

title: Energetic Forum
content_preview: Hello to all, just got done playing around with a new toroid configured as a joule thief. The saying, you can't teach an old dog new tricks does not apply to this old dog. I am still amazed at the simplicity of this circuit and all the changes one can make to the circuit. I put some turns on an already wound toroid and got results. It almost seems like you can't not make it work. I have been trying different designs and am still amazed by it all. When I get the hang of this (posting), I'll,get some circuits up on here. I really enjoy all the ideas that are just bubbling up from the ether(net) . It seems that this internet inspired pool of tinkerers and thinkers is just the start of something bigger. Even if the quest for over unity is not achieved via joule thief, MEG, bedini SGS motor or whatever you like, they have inspired a lot of minds. I look forward to the progress.

title: Fro Maryborough 48 Volt solar system runs well
content_preview: Hi everyone. I built my 48 volt system with 1.5 KW of panels and a 1 KW wind turbine (Soma) with 24 2.2 Volt Sonnenschein batteries a few years ago. Works very well but I need to run my generator when there is no wind or sun like this time of the year although in total it was only run for 40 hours last year just to top up the batteries. Four people in the house (two teenagers) a wide screen LCD TV fridge, freezer, three computers etc all run no problem on this system which is not grid connected. In Summer our batteries go to float quite often. The entire system is probably worth about $60K now but with govt rebates cost only about $25K.

title: Energetic Forum
content_preview:
Hi, all! I'm a new member in Central Florida. Ummm....not really sure what to say about myself here. I'm a young(ish) mom of 2 boys, and I'm in a longterm committed relationship with my really great boyfriend. We've had a bit of a rough patch lately, and in the interest of keeping my relationship healthy and happy, I'm exploring more of my boyfriend's interests, which fortunately are mine as well, just ones I've never explored too deeply. Can't wait to start getting to know some people in here!

title: LENR and CF in Raleigh NC
content_preview: If anymembers are working on LENR or CF reactors I have Questions about My results and Power extraction method. Surely I'm measuring something wrong 120 V a/c diod plug to 120 dc in. After heating up cell near boiling.I use 230 v too warm up then switch to 120.At this point it runs on .5 too .8 amp. Once I start extracting the energy the input drops apx. .15 va to 20 watts and I'm extracting 150 dc 8 amps + . pink glow goes to whitesh sparkler look. Red glow dissapates from rod. The more you try to extract. the lower the input drops. Also the plasma will not appear unless I have a load on it. Once it reaches this level it seems to restart on lower voltages too. It also has one other Odd effect. The way to extract!!! I'm Using a 128 v 9.5 amp 1.41 hp servodisc. I can load the servodisc to practly a stall and the input on the cell actually drops to 5 watts. Yea I know dosn't sound right. I will rerun test again tomorrow. I don't have the best measuring equipment just a dig volt meters and a P3 killowatt meter on the A/C outlet. dig meter on the extraction point. more to follow might just be a fluke on my part. Randy

title: Energetic Forum
content_preview:
Hi Guys
this is my first post here at EF so i just wanted to say hello to you all. I have absolutely no electronics experience apart from the odd solder repair so, i am a bit out of my depth, however i am about to embark on my first Bedini SSG
I have all my components on order and i intend on using a stripped down vcr head drum as a bearing as i find these rotate real nice! I intend on staring with batteries but would like to get it self running on caps just for the sheer delight of seeing it work that way! So if anyone can point me in the direction of info on how to set that up (running on caps) i would be most grateful.
I also wanted to ask: if someone could look at the items i am about to use and tell me if they are correct/suitable, the ones marked - ?
2 N 3055 (STM)
1N4001 50V 1A
1N4007 1000V 1A
POT M7 500K linear - ?
430 OHM resistor - ?
Neon lamp
anyway i hope i have the right stuff on order since i have looked a so many variations of the circuit i am a bit confused lol
Well that's all i have to say/ask i can't wait to get started I will be sure to post my progress
keep up the amazing work everyone
best regards

title: Hi from Scotland
content_preview:
I keep getting this site in my google searches for info.....so I thought I should join. I'm an artist and make my living in the care sector.
My interests here are to try and understand the form of electromagnetic field in different types of coil....especially ones based on Tesla bifilar design.
I have no equipment to make or test designs, but love to invent, and my thoughts work in a visual manner.....but are able to handle abstractions also....up to a point, lol. My trouble is that I need to have more practical results in the form of visuals to work with.....like what do the magnetic field flux lines around a coil made from bifilar wire look like, where the wire is doubled back on itself as in the Tesla Bifilar coil...
That sort of thing :-)
Hi!

title: new- and with no assumptions
content_preview: Hellow, I'm from the UK and I'm very happy to be a member of this forum. Although from an engineering background I come with no assumptions about how things 'should work'. I am here to learn and hopefully in time contribute something uplifting, positive and maybe even useful. My belief is that energy is ubiquitous, free and limitless. The issue is not wether it exists, but how we can understand it and release it safely into our limited paradigm of useful work. For me understanding energy is as much a philosophical challenge as it is technical one. I sincerly respect those who have sacrificed time, reputation and many a good night's sleep in the quest to walk that lonely road for the benefit of others.

title: Net gains with HHO
content_preview:
Hello boys and girls. I don't anticipate that I will have much time to spend here on this forum but I did want to stop in to say hi and make a brief announcement.
I know there's been some talk here of my new Batt-Cell. Be watching for my next YouTube video, or visit my Justin.tv channel to check out recorded videos there of some of the fun I had Sunday with it on my B&S test stand. Sent the following Tweet this morning...
I DID IT!!! My >2:1 eff ROI held true. With my 5.9 MMW Batt-Cell & 48% ttl pwr conv eff, POSTED NET GAIN TTL SYS EFFICIENCY!!! Plz retweet!
If you recall my first series of tests with the B&S motor, my total power conversion efficiency from output of shaft to energy value of HHO was only 34% with no more than 4mmw efficiency on my decaying VSPB cell and 60% eff alternator. From that I was able to document 69% ROI. Last night using my new Batt-Cell with a total power conversion efficiency of 48%, I was able to document ~103% ROI! (x2.146)
That's correct, folks. As I predicted through extrapolation from the first sets of data, I now have documented, verifiable, repeatable, peer reviewable, honest to goodness NET GAINS!!! The engine RAN LONGER at no load and under static load when adding the load presented by the cell and reinjecting the HHO back into the carb. Extrapolate what happens further if the alternator is 71% efficient. 57% pwr conv. 122% ROI! Now make the cell 6.7mmw (90% eff). That's 64% pwr conv. 137% ROI.
More live tests tonight. Speadsheets of the collected data and edited videos to follow.
Cheers!
Z

Learning about radar transmitting-receiving, magnets and the ins and outs of what there is to know about Ohms Law and all that goes with it.
In or about the year 2000, I started a more serious approach to combining gravity to assist magnetism, both being considered 'conservative' forces, if you cannot lick them join them. I now have gone strictly 'gravity' and the pursuit of rediscovering the workings of Johann Bessler.
In 2009 I went public after being recommended by word of mouth as the person to contact for need of assistance with gravity wheel designs.
I formed and registered the organization known as 'Arrache' http://www.arrache.org/
Since my retirement in 2002 I devote the better part of my time in my own machine and carpenter shop building unique or questionable designs for people with the idea but not the resources, skills or aptitude to build themselves.
Recognized by PESwiki and 10 other energy related forums (charter member to some) and being acquainted with people way before Bill Gates and 3.1, I feel as old as energy saving fur-lined bath tubs to keep the water warm.
Ralph Lortie
CEO 'Arrache'

title: home made solar panels
content_preview:
Solar panels are considered to be very effective in reducing the electricity bill. In the early years, electricity generated from the solar panels was very expensive and many people were not ready to use it. But in the past few years, the technology has shown tremendous miracles and made this eco-friendly form of energy more efficient and less expensive. So, now it is an affordable form of energy. But before going to buy any such product, you should do a proper solar panel efficiency comparison, which will help you to choose the best solar panel for your home or office. The most important thing is for how much time the sun shines at your place. If you are living at a place where the sun shines just for 1 to 2 hours then installing a solar panel will be of no use.Technology is the second factor. You should go for a solar panel which is facilitated with new technology. This will make your solar panel more efficient as the technology is improving day by day.
Do you have a place from where the sunlight can come directly to the panels without any obstructions. As shades may reduce the panels efficiency to a great extent, finding such a place is very important. Solar panel for your home will also depend upon the size of your house. If your house is very big you need to be prepared for a greater cost and a bigger panel to get the perfect efficiency.
Earth4Energy

title: Complete newbie with many thoughts
content_preview:
Hi All,
The whole area of alternative energies excite me greatly.
My biggest worry about getting started in my projects and experiments is that I have no electronics experience at all. My career and experience is in computers. However, I do have a good logical mind.
I would imagine that I will start of by building a Bedini SSG motor. I do have one question on this before I even start. I have heard somewhere that you get better recharging performance of your second battery if you use capacitors and pulse the power in. However, I very seldom see this in anyones designs. Is the capacitor theory correct?
I also plan to look into the area of magnetic shielding and permanent magnets similar to the John Ecklin motor.
I also want to look at U shaped electro magnets. My thoughts are that all of the motor designs I see that use pulsing electro magnets are inefficient as they only use one side the the magnet. If you use 2 rotar wheels with a gap in between them. One wheel say has N pole magnets and the other one with N pole magnets that are offset a few degrees back. With one pulse of the electromagnet you will repulse the N pole magnet on wheel 1, as per normal, but you will also attract the N pole magnet on wheel 2. An extra free bang for your buck.
Anyway, glad to be in the thick of things.

title: Energetic Forum
content_preview:
I'm not great at introducing myself (on any level), so I'll just throw it all out there for you to pick up what you will...
Originally I'm from southern Missouri, but now I live in Kentucky. I turned 29 this year, never been married and do not have any kids and still can't decide what I want to be when I "grow up". I spent some time in the military (Infantry), did my thing, got out and tried moving on with my life.
Unfortunately, I feel like I'm caught in a stand-still.
I love learning as much as I can, but can't stand being lied to or being taught someone else's opinion in the form of a fact - I want to know if something is unknown so I can move forward to finding it out for sure. I enjoy Psychology, Philosophy, Physics, Biology, Chemistry, Genetics and Filmography (I'm terrible at Math but truly respect it).
I'm one nasty political agenda away from total paranoia and sometimes swear that I'm going crazy.
I love the idea of being self-sufficient and making my own electricity and growing/hunting my own food (that's part of the reason I'm here).
I'm just now going to college for the first time in my life (starting tomorrow, 05/10/2011) through online classes and have set my major for Psychology, emphasizing in marriage counseling (though I've never been married, it's disheartening to see folks marry and divorce on a whim, and give no mind to the bond in their vows they make to each other. I've always been of the opinion, if someone can't be trusted for keeping their word, they can't be trusted at all). I understand marriage can be demanding, so I think the decision to engage should be even more so.
I try to be as open as possible, but if there's something I don't feel comfortable discussing I'll respectfully let it be known.
If anyone has any questions for me - personal or otherwise - feel free to ask. I will.
Have a nice day!

title: Energetic Forum
content_preview:
I'm new here and found this forum after running across a site trying to sell a $47 book on the Tesla Generator, AKA free electricity from thin air. I did a Google search and ended up getting the full book here for free!
I started pulling wires and bending conduit on side jobs with my father at age 7 or 8; I've ALWAYS been fascinated with electricity. Nothing excites me more than a good, strong lightning storm. I was a mediocre student in school and particularly in algebra. My mind rebelled at doing math with letters until our assistant principal took over our shop class, broke it up into sections instead of just letting us loose in the shop and I took basic electricity. E = I x R!!! Now I got it!! Took vocational electronics the next year and was accepted to Valparaiso Technical Institute after graduation. Parents were divorced so the college plan failed so I went with the Navy education and became an FTM. (Fire Control Technician, Missiles) I learned machine language computers, data converters and peripherals, and radar systems. (microwave propagation) After the Navy I worked as an entry level electronics bench tech but found better pay as an industrial electrician. Later I ended up in a steel mill as a motor inspector and learned about DC motor/generator circuits and controls and overhead crane circuits. Later on I took their upgrade courses to become a full multi-craft electrician encompassing industrial electronics and instrumentation, PLC programming, high power RF oscillators and up to 13.8 KV sub-station switch-gear. (Also welding and torch work)
In the mean time I learned (with a little help from another forum) to upgrade and build PCs and did TV repairs on the side for fun and just a little profit. I've repaired about every appliance over the years except microwave ovens.
I'm a family man with 3 kids and 6 grand children. In my spare time I fish, camp, hunt and enjoy spending my off time at our little river place 80 miles away from this city. I've got a mot

title: East Coast REPRESENT!
content_preview:
New forum member here, lurked for a few days due to not wishing to sign up with my work email.
Are there any other folks from the East Coast?
I'm from Pennsylvania - and feel like a kid kicking stones to think that a bunch of you folks meet up in Idaho.
There is a somewhat like-minded event nearby.
The Pennsylvania Renewable Energy Festival
But I've never been to that 'festival' - but I'd like to. It always seems to occur during the worst of my work schedule.
Hopefully this time around.
I'm mostly interested in HHO, although I have yet to have any real success. I think it's pitiful that the Renault R10's that my dad owned would get about the same mileage as my commuter that's 40 years newer. The stereo system is a bit better in my ride, but other than than that, I drive a no-frills '07 Chevy Aveo.
I'm looking forward to tinkering, learning and sharing my results with the group.
Regards,
Bruce

I made a few posts without having first making an introduction. My apologies.
FWIW:
I am an inventor by trade (one trade, at least), and what I invent are, for the most part, machines that affect human awareness.
Although definitely not a materialist like most of them, I am a transhumanist, someone who believes that human beings can be improved upon with technology, ad infinitum. My priorities in this endeavor are (in order) enhancing:
Emotional function
Intelligence
Physical healing
Immunity to disease and other adverse conditions
Page 17 - http://www.mindmachines.com/FreeJour...3.1%20free.pdf
as well as research into altered states of consciousness. I was, when it was still legal, a designer of recreational drugs for a couple of years. We were not attempting to make addictive drugs, but either fun ones or those that would allow entirely new experiences. To do no harm was a priority.
I am also very knowledgeable concerning cognitive-enhancing drugs, having had, no doubt, more of them than anyone else, ever.
I discovered, in September / October of 2003, that certain wavelengths of infrared light have a cognitive-enhancing effect on human beings.
Page 3 - http://www.mindmachines.com/FreeJour...4.1%20free.pdf
This was "discovered" yet again five years later by credentialed scientists in europe (search web for "Alzheimers helmet").
I am not at all fluent in electronics, but I learn what I need to know quickly. This is purposeful as I believe many of the accepted models are in question.
I am very interested in alternative physics, as in on-the-bench experiments.
I believe that healing machines such as Lee Crock's "Aura Cleaner"
Lee Crock Aura Therapy - 03/09/00
and weather control devices such as David Wells' or Trevor Constable's devices, and "free energy" machines are all intimately related as to mechanism of action.

title: and something on capacitors ...
content_preview:
Hi everyone,
I am interested in re-educating myself by starting from a clean slate, as to how inductors and capitors really work, and to try and cleanse my mind from the missconceptions we have been taught by many of our school teachers and text books. Once we achieve the correct understanding of how these things work then free energy machines like the Testatika ( ‪Testatika Machine‬‏ - YouTube ) will be easily understood.
The main difficulty with learning is filtering out the small bits of correct information from the multitude of information on this forum and elsewhere out on the internet.
I hope to be able to put together a simple set of documents and terminology which will describe the true behaviour of electrical components so that we can all understand and describe things in a meaningfull way. Today the main problem we face is when trying to describe a system and using terms which are not precisely defined or which have multiple meanings. For example the term "charge" as used in capacitance, is over used and is interpreted by many people differently and incorrectly. See the the links below to be enlightened
The following two links I found very interesting in dealing with capacitors.
First link describes capacitance, Second link is a Utube demo.
ELECTRICITY MISCONCEPTIONS: Capacitor
‪MIT Physics Demo -- Dissectible Capacitor‬‏ - YouTube
I think the schematic for a self running generator is not far off and will be a combination of a wimshurst machine coupled together with something like the imotep bedini fan project ( ‪Imhotep - Bedini Fan Project Part 1‬‏ - YouTube ), where the wimshurst will provide the voltage to power the imotep fan which in turn will spin the wimshurst machine at a constant rate just like the Testatika.
cheers

title: Using the Hull Effect to enhance the transmutation of matter into the 4th state
content_preview:
A Big Hello to Everyone from joepipe here in Mission, BC
A few days ago Robert emailed me concerning how the Hull Effect may enhance the flame energy generated by the joepipe technology.
After reading over some of the posts, the joepipe (as it is made up of heavy metal piping) should become magnetized in the same manner as a vehicle through generating the Hull Effect.
Robert suggested wrapping a ss wire around a ceramic pipe in order to induce the Hull Effect into the air-fuel mix.
The joepipe uses low pressure-high volume air to generate an implosion spin inside of a pipe. Increasing the Btu of the fuel along with the air flow increases the endothermic spin generated by the vacuum produced.
Please give me awhile to read through the various posts so that I'll be able to gain the insight needed to fully understand the Hull Effect.
Joshua.
Adding the Hull Effect into the equation may be the missing variable to phase change the matter (fuel-air mix) into full blown plasma.
On many occasions I've witnessed the joepipe become thermally super-conductive where the fuel was transmuted into the 4th state of matter. The Hull Effect may be the catylist. The joepipe itself works on 'lamiter flow.'

title: Greetings from the Middle East
content_preview:
Hello:
I am an Ex-Pat Contractor operating in the Middle East (SE - SW Asia). "Amazing" that none of these countries have gone solar and wind for internal energy consumption and reserved oil for selling on the global market. Too easy.
At any rate, I am contractually restricted from stating with any degree of specificity my physical location or what I do. Suffice it to say I operate in the Middle East and spend most nights hunting bombs and homicidal socio-paths.
I am looking to retire in the next 2 - 3 years and reside part of the time on the west coast of Florida and the remainder of the year elsewhere, Belize, Philippines, El Salvador ... I am in the process of purchasing some land for residential development in Florida ... west coast, bay side and would like to avoid utility companies all together.
So, I am open for any and all suggestions regarding energy production ... I'm considering solar panels and perhaps 2 - 3 windmills to provide electricity for a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom pre-fab, eco-friendly A-Frame in Florida. Anyone have some guidance to offer? Journey well, The Contractor

title: Hello everyone from the new guy
content_preview:
Hello all,
This is my first post. Generally I've avoided forums except to do research. I've never posted anything prior to the last month. Only recently did I started posting my current project on youtube . It was difficult to start and is very time consuming. It takes away from my project but I'm compelled to show my results.
Why? Because I'm like most of you... I want a clean renewable free (or nearly free) source of energy. I think that collaboration among ordinary like minded individuals is the only way we will ever see it. Furthermore I believe that my project has merit and at the very least is interesting to those who are like minded.
Having said that let me describe what I am doing. Nothing extraordinary with exception of the speed of the device. It is a pulsed dc motor currently running at a maximum speed of 75,000 rpm . It is a ring magnet diametrically magnetized mounted on a quarter inch shaft being driven by a set of 13ea. 1" pancake coils wired in series. I call it the P-Motor.
I have many theories and ideas of what to do with this device and I am looking for collaboration. Youtube thus far (only one month) has provided me nothing in the way of collaboration. NOTTA Zip Nothing. As one would probably expect given the amount of time and that I haven't properly networked in forums such as this.
So here I am dragging my feet, not really wanting to do this but finding that it is probably the only way to organize a collaborative effort.
I won't go into details about the project here but hopefully I will get someones attention and I will start a thread in order to move the project forward.
The goal of course is OU. Am I close. I don't really know but I am encouraged enough to pursue it further. I am proposing an experiment based on high speed rotation and orientation to a timed discharge among other things. I won't bother you with the details they are all documented on youtube for everyone to view and critique.
My user name on youtube is mnsman1 . As of now I'

title: inquiring about lenzes law
content_preview:
Hi, Im new to this forum.
I am making an enquiry on behalf of a freind. he like me has very little time, resources and knowledge.
He seems to think that if he were to wire the primary of a transformer in an H bridge pattern of transistors thereby being able to square wave pulse the primary alternately.
(ie one pulse goes in one end and the next pulse goes in the opposite end and so on, possibly at resonant frequency or not? ,50 % duty cycle), that the inputted pulse would always be travelling in the same direction or in harmony with the inducted current in the primary from the magnet flux generated by the secondary,,, and the magnetic flux generated by the input pulse would reinforce the already existing flux generated by the secondary. Pulsed this way , he thinks that the core of the transformer could be driven into saturation with a lot less power. Then harvesting the back emf of the primary(bedini styles great idea) to charge a battery and recifying the secondarys he would have COP>1.
I think that it is a silly idea and that he should pursue some of the more practicle ideas but he wont listen to me. but I could be wrong.
If I were to show him the reasoning of more experiened people who have a deeper understanding of the interplay that goes on in transformers with respect to flux paths, induction, reinduction of primarys from secondarys,
lenzes law ect, to explain to him why hes wasting his time, we could put this matter to rest and move on.
Any input regarding the above would be appreciated.
Regards Lotec

title: Complete Amateur Trying to Break Into OU Power Generation
content_preview:
Hello everyone. I'm here because I'm an inventor at heart. I'd probably make a good industrial designer, since I have lots of ideas, but no real technical skill to fill in the gaps. I've never had any formal training of any kind, but I love to come up with new ways of making things work.
After many hours spent on youtube, looking at wind turbines, and trying to figure out how to make my own, I stumbled across the mag lev pulse generator designed by skycollection.
After seeing his design in action, I thought to myself: "what would happen if you took the same design, extended the shaft, and packed on a bunch of rotors to spin past another bunch of stators, secured to something outside the shaft (to reduce weight)?"
In theory, if you could get enough torque from a pulse motor like skycollection's design, you could put one at each end of a longer shaft, add in more mag lev supports to handle the weight, stack rotors in the middle, and produce a butt-load of extra energy.
You could potentially use several pickup coils, or a couple of the stators, to power the roding starship coils, removing the need for an outside power source, while the rest of them went to charging a battery bank.
At least that's the theory. It doesn't seem to implausible to me, especially after seeing skycollection's new dual core compressed starship coils with the ferrite core, which he claims has incredible torque on a 6 magnet rotor.
If I'm way off base with this one, let me know. As I said, I've never tried this before, and everything I know about electronics, and OU generators, I've learned through blogs and youtube
Thanks,
TinMan
